output.summary: The claim was denied because prior authorization was not obtained. Submit a retroactive authorization request and note why earlier precedents do not apply.

items.text: Provide a retroactive authorization request for the sleep study.
Complete and submit the retroactive authorization form to the insurer within the allowed filing window.
The inpatient pre‑auth precedent (F-INPATIENT-RETRO) does not apply because it concerns inpatient services, not a facility‑based sleep study.
The MRI pre‑auth precedent (F-MRI-REFERRAL) is unrelated; it requires a specialist referral for MRI, not a retroactive request for a sleep study.
The sleep‑study retroactive‑auth precedent (F-SLEEP-RETRO) is contradicted by higher‑level rules R-HC-010 and R-HC-011, so it cannot be relied upon.
Even with a retroactive request, approval is not guaranteed under the current policy clause.
